EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in the American studies MA at ASU!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in Arizona State University's master's in American studies program through the School of Historical, Philosophical and Religious Studies. We are excited that you are considering joining the ASU community. Here is some information to get you started on your journey:
Program description and admission requirements: http://shprs.clas.asu.edu/graduate/american-studies-ma
How to apply: http://shprs.clas.asu.edu/graduate/applying-0
American studies faculty: http://shprs.clas.asu.edu/graduate/american-studies-faculty
Please review these sites closely, and contact me at Roxanne.Shand@asu.edu with any additional questions you may have.
Sincerely,
Roxanne Shand Graduate Program Coordinator School of Historical, Philosophical and Religious Studies College of Liberal Arts and Sciences
